# Font Awesome Free (local)

- Package: `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@6.7.2` from npm.
- Files: `css/all.min.css` and its referenced `webfonts/` files.
- License: see `LICENSE.txt` in this directory (icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT).
- The app serves these files from `127.0.0.1`; the browser does not request the Font Awesome CDN.
- To upgrade, replace CSS, referenced fonts and license from the same package version together.
